## Software used in HYDRA-EO tutorials

This page summarises the main R packages and tools used in the tutorials,
with links to their Git repositories and simple usage examples.

---

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
R · ToolsRTM
:::

### Canopy & leaf RTMs

The **ToolsRTM** package provides a unified suite of radiative transfer
models for simulating leaf, canopy, and soil reflectance across multiple
sensor resolutions. It integrates **PROSPECT**, **FLUSPECT**, **Liberty**,
**INFORM**, **fourSAIL**, and **PROSAIL** for detailed optical simulations,
as well as advanced modelling components such as **SPART** and
**MARMIT** for soil reflectance.

These capabilities support flexible, physics-based workflows for Earth
Observation data analysis and model–data integration.

![](../assets/GitLab-Logo.png){.footer-logo}[ToolsRTM package](https://gitlab.com/caminoccg/toolsrtm)

:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
R · SCOPEinR
:::

### Energy balance & SIF

The **SCOPEinR** package implements the SCOPE model for simulating soil–canopy
radiative transfer, photosynthesis, fluorescence, and surface energy
balance. It provides tools and an R interface for producing consistent reflectance,radiance
and fluoresence emission, and photosynthesis products under varying stress, physiological, canopy properties and
illumination conditions.


This package supports detailed modelling of vegetation functioning in
crop studies and stress analysis.

![](../assets/GitLab-Logo.png){.footer-logo}[SCOPEinR package](https://gitlab.com/caminoccg/scopeinr)
:::

:::
